name: git-visualizer
description: A local desktop Git visualization and conflict-resolution application.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 dist-electron/electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist-electron/electron/main.js"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
